synergies.links.ssanggeom.name: Twin Swords United
synergies.links.ssanggeom.desc: Swing the Three Powers Sword while the Azure Sky Sword Qi orbits and the two sword qi overlap: that stroke deals 60% more damage and turns gold.
synergies.links.ssanggeom.lore: Namgung and Mount Hua quarreled for a hundred years. Two swordsmen who first stood back to back in the Blood Calamity left this technique.
synergies.links.geomhwa.name: Sword Blossom
synergies.links.geomhwa.desc: Three plum petals bloom where the Three Powers Sword cuts and scatter like Falling Petal Sword Rain shots.
synergies.links.geomhwa.lore: Even the basic sword blooms. It is the first thing a new Mount Hua disciple hears.
synergies.links.gwonjang.name: Fist and Palm as One
synergies.links.gwonjang.desc: The last punch of an Arhat Fist combo fires a short Palm Wind. 50% of Palm Wind damage, piercing.
synergies.links.gwonjang.lore: Close the hand and it is a fist; open it and it is a palm. Shaolin and the Beggars' Sect teach the same words differently.
synergies.links.geumganghu.name: Vajra Roar
synergies.links.geumganghu.desc: When the Sonic Art rings while you strike with the Arhat Fist, the sound wave radius grows 40% and the stun chance doubles.
synergies.links.geumganghu.lore: Arhat Hall trainees shout as they punch.
synergies.links.dokbi.name: Venom Daggers
synergies.links.dokbi.desc: Flying daggers that pass through Poison Mist carry the poison, poisoning the enemies they hit and gaining +1 pierce.
synergies.links.dokbi.lore: The Dang Clan always passes a dagger through the mist once before throwing it.
synergies.links.amgi.name: Hidden Weapon Chain
synergies.links.amgi.desc: When the Flash Finger lands a critical hit, a flying dagger follows to that enemy.
synergies.links.amgi.lore: Where the finger points, the blade goes.
synergies.links.inroe.name: Lightning-Drawing Sword
synergies.links.inroe.desc: Lightning that strikes while the Azure Sky Sword Qi orbits rides the sword ring once around, shocking the enemies inside it.
synergies.links.inroe.lore: It began with a single talisman a Kunlun Taoist lent to a Namgung swordsman.
synergies.links.punghwa.name: Wind and Fire
synergies.links.punghwa.desc: Palm Wind that passes a burning enemy carries the flame, grows 30% larger and burns the enemies it hits.
synergies.links.punghwa.lore: Wind feeds fire. The beggars learned it in front of campfires on winter nights.
synergies.links.jeomhyeol.name: Pressure Point Spear
synergies.links.jeomhyeol.desc: Enemies hit by the Flash Finger have a pressure point sealed and freeze for 0.5 seconds; a Pear Blossom Spear thrust into them always crits.
synergies.links.jeomhyeol.lore: Seal the point first, thrust after. It is the order the Waterway Fort bandits use on deck.
synergies.links.noehwa.name: Thunder and Fire
synergies.links.noehwa.desc: When lightning falls near where a Thunderclap Bomb burst, the explosion goes off once more at double the area.
synergies.links.noehwa.lore: When thunder meets gunpowder, mountains wail.
synergies.links.hyeoldok.name: Blood Venom
synergies.links.hyeoldok.desc: Claw a poisoned enemy with the Blood Claw and the poison spreads through the blood to enemies within 2m.
synergies.links.hyeoldok.lore: This is said to be the first page of the blood venom recipe the Blood Shadow Society handed to the Dang Clan.
synergies.links.geommyeong.name: Singing Sword
synergies.links.geommyeong.desc: When an orbiting Taiji Sword meets a sound wave, the sword sings and sends out one more small sound wave on the spot.
synergies.links.charyeok.name: Borrowed Force
synergies.links.charyeok.desc: An enemy pulled in by the Chain Sickle that touches a Taiji Sword is flung back the other way with the same force and crashes into the enemies behind it.
synergies.links.charyeok.lore: Borrow another's strength to strike another. The first and last principle Wudang teaches.
synergies.links.chwijung.name: Drunken Plum Blossoms
synergies.links.chwijung.desc: The Drunken Immortal Staff gathers drifting petals into a petal whirlwind that circles you for 2 seconds.
synergies.links.chwijung.lore: They say a beggar once swung a staff drunk in the plum grove of Mount Hua.
synergies.links.gyeonin.name: Pull and Strike
synergies.links.gyeonin.desc: The Drunken Immortal Staff bats away enemies dragged in by the chain. If a flung enemy hits another enemy, both take damage.
synergies.links.gyeonin.lore: The work is easy when one side pulls and the other strikes.
synergies.links.hyeolchang.name: Blood Spear
synergies.links.hyeolchang.desc: Enemies run through by the Pear Blossom Spear bleed for 3 seconds; clawing a bleeding enemy with the Blood Claw triples lifesteal.
synergies.links.hyeolchang.lore: The Blood Wolf Troop opens the wound with spears and reaps with claws.
synergies.schools.shaolin.name: Shaolin
synergies.schools.shaolin.tiers.2.desc: The first time Vitality drops below 50%, eighteen Arhat phantoms surround you for 5 seconds and push away enemies they touch (three times per run)
synergies.schools.wudang.name: Wudang
synergies.schools.wudang.tiers.0.desc: The Taiji zone widens from ±25 to ±35
synergies.schools.wudang.tiers.1.desc: Four Ounces Move a Thousand Pounds: while in the Taiji zone, damage taken -20%, and ten times the damage prevented is returned to enemies that touch you
synergies.schools.huashan.name: Mount Hua
synergies.schools.huashan.tiers.1.desc: Every critical hit throws three plum petals that cut nearby enemies
synergies.schools.gaebang.name: Beggars' Sect
synergies.schools.gaebang.tiers.2.desc: Every 3 minutes, three Beggars' Sect disciples appear and fight beside you for 10 seconds
synergies.schools.tang.name: Sichuan Dang Clan
synergies.schools.tang.tiers.1.desc: When a poisoned enemy falls, the poison spreads 2m around it
synergies.schools.tang.tiers.2.desc: Every 20 seconds, a poison needle strikes every enemy on screen
synergies.schools.namgung.name: Namgung Clan
synergies.schools.namgung.tiers.1.desc: Every third sword technique attack, a sword qi plunges from the sky
synergies.schools.waterfort.name: Yangtze Waterway Fort
synergies.schools.waterfort.tiers.1.desc: Lightfoot distance +50%; enemies you pass through are dragged along
synergies.schools.waterfort.tiers.2.desc: Elite Treasure Chests give one more technique upgrade
synergies.schools.kunlun.name: Kunlun
synergies.schools.kunlun.tiers.0.desc: Enemies frozen by a Stilling Talisman stay frozen twice as long
synergies.schools.demonic.name: Demonic Path
synergies.schools.demonic.tiers.0.desc: Lifesteal x2, but food healing is halved. The Blood Demon's Whisper appears more often
synergies.common.name: Mastery of the Basics
synergies.common.desc: With the Three Powers Sword at Lv8, your most-gathered sect gains one more Lineage step. All martial learning branches out from the basics.
synergies.secrets.nakmae_geomseon.name: Blood of the Fallen Plum Sword Immortal
synergies.secrets.nakmae_geomseon.condit: Be born a Mount Hua disciple, have Falling Petal Sword Rain Lv8 and Plum Blossom Method Lv5, and have cleared Chapter 5 (Mount Hua) before
synergies.secrets.nakmae_geomseon.reward: Falling Petal Sword Rain becomes the secret art 'Falling Plum, One Sword' (落梅一劍), and the One Sword ultimate breaks three times like a plum branch
synergies.secrets.nakmae_geomseon.hint.0: One who shared the name buried a sword on the cliff
synergies.secrets.nakmae_geomseon.hint.1: When the plum blooms again, that sword will weep
synergies.secrets.eogang.name: Corpse Taming
synergies.secrets.eogang.condition: Holding the Thunder Talisman, Chain Sickle and Taoist Gate Method, use three or more Stilling Talismans in one run
synergies.secrets.eogang.reward: Drag a jiangshi frozen by a Stilling Talisman in with the chain to re-stick the talisman on its forehead and command it for 30 seconds (up to ten)
synergies.secrets.eogang.hint.0: A talisman does more than make them stop
synergies.secrets.eogang.hint.1: Whose side is the one bound at the chain's end on?
synergies.secrets.maehwa_samnong.name: Plum Blossom Three Variations
synergies.secrets.maehwa_samnong.conditi: Have the Sonic Art, Falling Petal Sword Rain and Plum Blossom Method all at Lv5 or higher
synergies.secrets.maehwa_samnong.reward: Every third sound wave raises a plum blossom storm that fills the screen
synergies.secrets.maehwa_samnong.hint.0: When the zither sounds three times
synergies.secrets.mugeuk.name: Wuji
synergies.secrets.mugeuk.condition: Holding Taiji Sword Lv8 and Two Forms Method Lv5, keep the Yin-Yang gauge at 0 without moving a single notch for 3 minutes
synergies.secrets.mugeuk.reward: The Yin-Yang gauge disappears and every technique gets both the Yin and Yang bonus (+40%)
synergies.secrets.chwiseon.name: Drunken Immortal
synergies.secrets.chwiseon.condition: With the Drunken Immortal Staff and Wine Immortal Art, eat fifteen foods in one run and open a Treasure Chest at or below 20% Vitality
synergies.secrets.chwiseon.reward: Each food you eat stacks Might +3%, and your staggering steps let attacks slide off 20% of the time
synergies.secrets.yeokcheon.name: Defying Heaven
synergies.secrets.yeokcheon.condition: At an extreme (±70), break Backlash with Lightfoot within 1 second three times in a row
synergies.secrets.yeokcheon.reward: Backlash never returns for the rest of the run, and the extreme bonus stays
synergies.secrets.hyeolhae_janpyeon.name: Fragment of the Blood Sea Demon Art
synergies.secrets.hyeolhae_janpyeon.cond: Holding the Blood Claw and Blood Sea Method, with three or more Medical Books gathered, break a Silver Lantern
synergies.secrets.hyeolhae_janpyeon.rewa: The Blood Demon's Whisper is certain to appear that run. Accept it to gain the Blood Art, and the story leans toward the Inheritance ending
synergies.secrets.hyeolhae_janpyeon.hint: is tucked a page written in blood
synergies.secrets.mumyeong.name: Nameless Sword
synergies.secrets.mumyeong.condition: With no other attack technique, pass 10 minutes of game time with only the Three Powers Sword at Lv8
synergies.secrets.mumyeong.reward: Three Powers Sword damage +50%, Ultimate Art charge x2. Kept even if you learn new techniques later
synergies.secrets.mumyeong.hint.0: The one who swung the simplest sword
synergies.encounters.cliff.name: Cliff Encounter
synergies.encounters.cliff.where: The cliff at the map's edge in walled chapters (Prologue, Chapters 3, 4, 5)
synergies.encounters.cliff.how: Leap off the cliff with Lightfoot. Once per run
synergies.encounters.cliff.reward: A manual on the cave wall below: one of your techniques gains +2 levels, or learn one locked technique for this run
synergies.encounters.hermit.name: Hidden Master
synergies.encounters.hermit.where: An old man playing go in a corner of the map, in any chapter
synergies.encounters.hermit.how: Stay beside him for 6 seconds. Enemies keep coming all the while
synergies.encounters.hermit.reward: Choose one more breakthrough Insight. Opens a conversation with Elder Mok at the inn
synergies.encounters.relic.name: Remains of a Master
synergies.encounters.relic.where: A fallen master of that land's sect (a Shaolin monk in Chapter 1, a Dang Clan warrior in Chapter 2 …)
synergies.encounters.relic.how: Approach and stand still for 1 second to pay respects
synergies.encounters.relic.reward: Counts as one more Lineage step of that sect for this run
synergies.encounters.elixir.name: Elixir
synergies.encounters.elixir.where: A glowing vine or a crack in the rock (thousand-year fleeceflower root, stalactite milk)
synergies.encounters.elixir.reward: Ultimate Art gauge full, Yin-Yang gauge 0
synergies.encounters.spiritbeast.name: Spirit Beast
synergies.encounters.spiritbeast.where: Each chapter's spirit beast (white crane in Chapter 4, snow ginseng child in Chapter 6)
synergies.encounters.spiritbeast.how: Chase it down and catch it as it runs, like the Golden Toad
synergies.encounters.letter.name: Lower Five Gates Letter
synergies.encounters.letter.where: A note Unnang hid inside a lantern
synergies.encounters.letter.reward: One more line of the condition for an undiscovered Secret Legacy is revealed
synergies.encounters.whisper.name: The Blood Demon's Whisper
synergies.encounters.whisper.where: A red stone statue that appears after 15 minutes of game time
synergies.encounters.whisper.how: Use your Ultimate Art before the statue to accept; walk past to refuse
synergies.encounters.whisper.reward: Accept to gain the Blood Art and one Demonic Path Lineage step. The price: healing halved and the mark of the Inheritance ending
synergies.encounters.sword_tomb.name: Sword Tomb
synergies.encounters.sword_tomb.where: The sword grave atop the cliffs of Mount Hua in Chapter 5
synergies.encounters.sword_tomb.how: Plant one sword (discard one attack technique for this run)
synergies.encounters.sword_tomb.reward: Might +3% to your remaining techniques for each level of the discarded technique

dialogue.intro.cuts.c02.lines.0.text: The orthodox sects, the unorthodox sects and the Demonic Cult stood on the same side for the first time.
dialogue.intro.cuts.c03.lines.0.text: With seven stones, they bound the Blood Demon.
dialogue.intro.cuts.c04.lines.0.text: Year 32 of Daeun, the full moon of the seventh month.
dialogue.prologue.hints.yinyang.text: The Taiji is tilting. Feed only one force and you fall into extremity; your Vitality runs backward.
dialogue.prologue.lines.start_reply.text: If I bar the door, where will the villagers hide?
dialogue.prologue.lines.first_levelup.te: My body's burning. Did that old man put this in me?
dialogue.prologue.lines.first_charge.tex: Nothing to do but dodge that.
dialogue.prologue.lines.elite_spawn_gang: That's Mr. Wang's axe. The butcher...
dialogue.prologue.lines.realm_ilryu.text: I can see all of Cheongun Town. The rain parts around me.
dialogue.prologue.lines.awaken_after.tex: The sword... moves on its own.
dialogue.prologue.cuts.burnout.lines.1.t: The borrowed inner power burned through his meridians.
dialogue.prologue.cuts.needle.lines.0.te: That was never yours. If you want to make it yours, walk again.
dialogue.mok.lines.lives_1.text: Everyone finds the first body strange. It's like running in another man's shoes.
dialogue.mok.lines.lives_3.text: Your third. Your pulse is steadier than the first time.
dialogue.mok.lines.lives_10.text: Your tenth. The body changes, but the soul grows calluses.
dialogue.mok.lines.lives_30.text: Thirty times. I know how sweet it is to always come back from death.
dialogue.mok.lines.lives_100.text: After a hundred, death won't frighten you. That is what frightens me most.
dialogue.mok.lines.stones_2.text: Two. Back then it took three days to set all seven.
dialogue.mok.lines.stones_3.text: Three. One by one, I remember the faces of those who kept the stones.
dialogue.mok.lines.stones_4.text: Four. It was around the fourth stone that the first of us fell.
dialogue.mok.lines.stones_5.text: Your hand goes cold when you hold one, doesn't it? That one's hands were always warm.
dialogue.mok.lines.stones_6.text: One left. Don't rush. When you're impatient, your pulse knows first.
dialogue.mok.lines.stones_7.text: All seven are here. Whether this ends with a sealing this time, even I can't say.
dialogue.mok.lines.realm_iryu.text: Second-Rate. Now the raindrops will turn aside before they touch your skin.
dialogue.mok.lines.realm_ilryu.text: At First-Rate, people look up to you. Don't acquire a taste for it.
dialogue.mok.lines.realm_jeoljeong.text: Peak. Now even the Lords of the Land know who you are.
dialogue.mok.lines.realm_chojeoljeong.te: The mountains must have looked the size of your palm. That one began spending people easily around then, too.
dialogue.mok.lines.realm_hwagyeong.text: Harmony Realm. I saw that same golden light in that valley three hundred years ago.
dialogue.mok.lines.realm_hyeongyeong_sho: Even at the Mystic Realm you lacked the stones. The shadow came after you because it wants you.
dialogue.mok.lines.realm_hyeongyeong_sea: The valley gate is open. Who waits inside, you'll learn when you go.
dialogue.mok.lines.zuohwa_first.text: You sat down yourself. Knowing when to sit, when there's no reason left to endure, is training too.
dialogue.mok.lines.zuohwa_repeat.text: Those who go seated wear peaceful faces. Those who go in a fever stay with you longer.
dialogue.mok.lines.zuohwa_shadow.text: You sat before the shadow could catch you. Well done.
dialogue.mok.lines.hermit_1.text: You sat by the old man at his go board. He didn't clear the board even with the horde coming, did he? A man like that sees many moves ahead.
dialogue.mok.lines.hermit_2.text: Did he let you take a move back? On a go board, you can't swap bodies and play again.
dialogue.mok.lines.hermit_3.text: Don't ask that old man's name. He gave it up. That's why he sits there.
dialogue.mok.lines.manuscript_1.text: You picked up a medical book. Steady hand, isn't it? Written through the night by lamplight.
dialogue.mok.lines.manuscript_2.text: The chapter on fevers. That winter, it saved the children of a mountain village.
dialogue.mok.lines.manuscript_3.text: Look at the margins. 'Not enough medicine.' The same words on every page.
dialogue.mok.lines.manuscript_4.text: Every page of this one has bled red. Let's say it was caught in the rain.
dialogue.mok.lines.manuscript_5.text: This prescription was never used. It was finished only after everyone who needed it was gone.
dialogue.mok.lines.manuscript_6.text: Almost all of them now. Strange. I remember the next page without reading it.
dialogue.mok.lines.manuscript_7.text: The seventh volume. The last page is blank. What that one left unfinished, I suppose I must finish.
dialogue.mok.lines.lord_wongak.text: Were you told it opened from inside? A gate always opens from inside first.
dialogue.mok.lines.lord_dang_sohye.text: Stopping poison with poison. Not from ignorance. From haste, I'd say.
dialogue.mok.lines.lord_ma_cheonpae.text: Wanting to be paid for the guarding. Three hundred years would wear anyone down.
dialogue.mok.lines.lord_hyeolheo.text: So you heard about the physician. Yes. A fine hand with the needle.
dialogue.mok.lines.lord_huashan_sword_so: That swordsman never cut, to the very end. The only one who believed it could still be healed.
dialogue.mok.lines.lord_seol_muhyang.tex: That mountain village was full of coughing. The children's foreheads burned like coals.
dialogue.mok.lines.lord_hyeokryeon_hwi.t: 'I won't lose anyone.' I heard those words three hundred years ago, too.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.first_open.text: Your body is spent. I can't let your soul go with it.
These are the children who died tonight. Choose one and walk again in that body.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.first_needle.text: This will sting. Another's body always does at first.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.first_send.text: This one won't rise as a jiangshi, then. That's enough.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.sect_shaolin.text: A Shaolin child. You needn't know the sutras. The fists remember.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.sect_gaebang.text: A body that has known hunger. What it eats turns to flesh quickly.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.sect_namgung.text: Namgung blood. While Vitality lasts the sword pierces the sky, but once it runs dry it breaks fast.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.sect_tang.text: A Dang body shrugs off poison. Never forget that poison and medicine share one root.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.sect_waterfort.te: Raised on the water. Light on its feet on land, too.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.sect_wudang.text: A Wudang body keeps yin and yang even. If it tips, steady your breath first.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.sect_huashan.text: Mount Hua. Grip the sword and you'll know it isn't the first sword this hand has held.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.sect_kunlun.text: A Kunlun child. Hands that write talismans run cold, and jiangshi hate that.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.sect_demonic.text: A Demonic Cult body. This art feeds on blood, and it doesn't stop when it's full.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.show_1.text: Three again tonight. The rain won't let up.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.show_2.text: You choose faster now. Not bad.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.show_3.text: Look at the faces of the two you didn't choose, too.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.reroll_first.text: Not to your liking? More children died tonight.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.reroll_many.text: Don't be so picky. A body isn't a robe.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.fourth_first.text: I'll show you four. One more to see is one more to hurt.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.same_sect.text: Two from the same mountain gate, tonight.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.female_first.text: A girl's body. Your senior brothers will call you Junior Sister. Answer them.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.trait_first.text: Every body is born with something. Feel the pulse and you'll know.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.trait_yakgol.text: A thin pulse, this one. But quick to learn.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.trait_danmyeong.t: This body won't last long. A fire that burns short burns hot.
dialogue.bedroom.lines.trait_dunjae.text: A slow one. What is learned slowly stays in the soul longer.
dialogue.cards.list.shaolin.intro: A thousand-year-old temple on Mount Song. The great house of the martial world, keeper of the Heavenly Pivot Stone for three hundred years.
dialogue.cards.list.shaolin.bodies.0: A sixteen-year-old novice bitten by a jiangshi on the gate stairs
dialogue.cards.list.shaolin.bodies.1: A fifteen-year-old acolyte who fell running to the bell tower to ring the great bell
dialogue.cards.list.shaolin.bodies.2: The youngest kitchen hand, caught after hiding children among the stone pagodas
dialogue.cards.list.gaebang.intro: The sect of every beggar under heaven. Rumor always runs faster than a beggar's feet.
dialogue.cards.list.gaebang.bodies.0: A fourteen-year-old beggar boy who died pounding on the shut city gate
dialogue.cards.list.gaebang.bodies.1: A three-knot disciple who hid children under a bridge and stood against a Blood Thrall horde
dialogue.cards.list.gaebang.bodies.2: A wandering beggar face down beside a broken wine jar, still holding his alms bowl
dialogue.cards.list.gaebang.femaleBodies: A fourteen-year-old beggar girl who died pounding on the shut city gate

dialogue.cards.list.namgung.intro: One of the Five Great Clans, wielding the sword of the azure sky. It lost its clan head on the first day of the Blood Rain.
dialogue.cards.list.namgung.bodies.0: An outer-hall swordsman who held the armory door to his last breath
dialogue.cards.list.namgung.bodies.1: An eighteen-year-old sword-bearer who fell beside the clan head he served
dialogue.cards.list.namgung.bodies.2: The fifteen-year-old youngest disciple, killed under the sword rack while choosing his own blade
dialogue.cards.list.namgung.femaleBodies: An outer-hall swordswoman who never sheathed her sword at the armory door
A seventeen-year-old sword-bearer who fell behind the clan head, holding the clan head's scabbard to her chest
The fifteen-year-old youngest disciple, killed under the sword rack while choosing a blade for her little brother
dialogue.cards.list.tang.intro: The Sichuan Dang Clan, famed for poison and hidden weapons. The poison meant to stop the jiangshi brought the house down first.
dialogue.cards.list.tang.bodies.0: An outer disciple who threw his last flying dagger from the bamboo-grove post
dialogue.cards.list.tang.bodies.1: A seventeen-year-old apothecary disciple who died clutching a box of antidote pills
dialogue.cards.list.tang.bodies.2: A boy of a branch family who went in to clear the poison mist and never came back
dialogue.cards.list.tang.femaleBodies.0: An outer disciple who threw her last flying dagger from the bamboo-grove post
dialogue.cards.list.tang.femaleBodies.1: A sixteen-year-old apothecary disciple who died clutching a box of antidote pills
dialogue.cards.list.tang.femaleBodies.2: A girl of a branch family who went in to clear the poison mist and never came back
dialogue.cards.list.waterfort.intro: Unorthodox river pirates who rule the Yangtze. Called bandits, yet they guarded the Heavenly Pearl Stone for generations.
dialogue.cards.list.waterfort.bodies.0: An eighteen-year-old oarsman who never let go of the refugee boat's oar
dialogue.cards.list.waterfort.bodies.1: A lookout dragged into the water by a Water Ghost from the reed-bed watchtower
dialogue.cards.list.waterfort.bodies.2: The fort's youngest, who fell on the burning dock putting people onto boats
dialogue.cards.list.waterfort.femaleBodi: A ferryman's seventeen-year-old daughter who never let go of the refugee boat's oar
A woman lookout dragged into the water by a Water Ghost from the reed-bed watchtower
The fort's youngest, who fell on the burning dock putting children onto boats
dialogue.cards.list.wudang.intro: The mountain of the Taiji above a sea of clouds. A Taoist sect whose head became the barrier that guards it.
dialogue.cards.list.wudang.bodies.0: A young Taoist who coughed up blood as his Vitality surged backward on the overturned Taiji floor
dialogue.cards.list.wudang.bodies.1: A fifteen-year-old Taoist acolyte who misstepped on a plank path sunk in cloud
dialogue.cards.list.wudang.bodies.2: A Taoist surrounded by jiangshi while pasting talismans on the Hall of the Three Pure Ones
A young Taoist nun who coughed up blood as her Vitality surged backward on the overturned Taiji floor
A fifteen-year-old Taoist acolyte girl who misstepped on a plank path sunk in cloud
A Taoist nun surrounded by jiangshi while pasting talismans on the Hall of the Three Pure Ones
dialogue.cards.list.huashan.intro: A sword sect on cliffs where plum blossoms fall. It gave its founder to the sealing three hundred years ago.
dialogue.cards.list.huashan.bodies.0: A seventeen-year-old sword page cut down with the falling petals in the plum grove
dialogue.cards.list.huashan.bodies.1: A second-generation disciple who blocked a rockslide on a narrow plank path and fell from the cliff
dialogue.cards.list.huashan.bodies.2: The tomb-keeper disciple who was first to look into the opened founder's tomb
dialogue.cards.list.huashan.femaleBodies: A sixteen-year-old sword page cut down with the falling petals in the plum grove
A second-generation disciple who blocked a rockslide on a narrow plank path and fell from the cliff
The tomb keeper's daughter, who stood with a lantern before the opened founder's tomb
dialogue.cards.list.kunlun.intro: A sect of talismans and thunder rites on the northwest snowfield. The red mist fell here first, a year ago.
dialogue.cards.list.kunlun.bodies.0: An outer disciple frozen where he stood on patrol in the blizzard
dialogue.cards.list.kunlun.bodies.1: A young Taoist bitten by an Ice Jiangshi while keeping the campfire
dialogue.cards.list.kunlun.bodies.2: A Kunlun disciple who spent every talisman and faced a Snow Wolf pack bare-handed

dialogue.cards.list.demonic.intro: The Heavenly Demon Cult of the Hundred Thousand Mountains. It lost its master's bloodline in the Blood Calamity and is the Blood Demon's oldest enemy.
dialogue.cards.list.demonic.bodies.0: A young cultist who refused to kneel to the Blood Shadow Society before the blood altar
dialogue.cards.list.demonic.bodies.1: A cultist who fell in the front rank of the spear formation, spear still raised
dialogue.cards.list.demonic.bodies.2: A fifteen-year-old trainee who died three days after joining the Blood Wolf Corps
dialogue.cards.list.demonic.femaleBodies: A young cultist girl who refused to kneel to the Blood Shadow Society before the blood altar

dialogue.unnang.lines.return_1.text: Different face, but you still knock the mud off your shoes at the door. Welcome back, Sowoon.
dialogue.unnang.lines.return_2.text: I won't ask what old Mok does in the back room. Don't ask about my business either.
dialogue.unnang.lines.lives_3.text: I kept the soup warm. New body, same empty stomach, right?
dialogue.unnang.lines.lives_10.text: Tenth time. I've decided to just leave your chopsticks out.
dialogue.unnang.lines.lives_30.text: After sending you off thirty times I should be crying by now, but somehow I only laugh.
dialogue.unnang.lines.lives_100.text: The hundredth. You've worn this doorsill right down.
dialogue.unnang.lines.facility_jangyeong: Key to the back storehouse. Old Mok wants books brought in.
dialogue.unnang.lines.facility_yakbang.t: The smell of brewing herbs drives customers off, I said. ...Not that there are any to drive off.
dialogue.unnang.lines.facility_daejangan: Smith Cheol is back. With a hammer ringing, this place feels lived in again.
dialogue.unnang.lines.facility_suryeondo: I cleared out the cave on the back hill. Do what you like there, just don't bring the inn down.
dialogue.unnang.lines.confess_1.text: You saw the ledger. ...Sit. I'll pour you a drink. This time I won't smile while I tell it.
dialogue.unnang.lines.confess_2.text: I'm the one who sold where the Seal Stones were. Saying I didn't know it was the Blood Shadow Society isn't even an excuse.
dialogue.unnang.lines.confess_3.text: From now on, what the Lower Five Gates knows, I'll sell only to you. I'll still charge. It's business.
dialogue.unnang.lines.letter_before.text: A note in the lantern? Guests leave all sorts of things behind. Toss it, toss it.
dialogue.unnang.lines.letter_after.text: That note was mine. If I'd handed it over openly, the Lower Five Gates would have noticed.
dialogue.unnang.lines.chat_before_1.text: You're my only guest again today. I hope it's two tomorrow.
dialogue.unnang.lines.chat_before_2.text: When the rain stops, first thing I'm doing is hanging a new sign. Cheongun Inn, in gold leaf.
dialogue.unnang.lines.chat_before_3.text: A smile is a merchant's capital. Try smiling a little yourself.
dialogue.unnang.lines.chat_after_1.text: I said a smile is a merchant's capital. Lately I'm running out of it.
dialogue.unnang.lines.chat_after_2.text: I joined the Lower Five Gates at fourteen. When you're hungry, you'll sell anything.
dialogue.unnang.lines.chat_after_3.text: I never spent a single coin of the silver they paid me. It's still under the soy jar.
dialogue.training.lines.open.text: Wooden swords instead of a broom for the yard. I'll clean up whatever breaks.
dialogue.training.lines.first_buy.text: What's carved into the soul stays even when the body changes. That's what old Mok says.
dialogue.training.lines.first_refund.tex: Taking it back is part of learning too. That's how I learned business.
dialogue.training.lines.first_max.text: That's yours now. Not something someone lent you.
dialogue.leaders.list.hyegong.yardUnknow: One rice ball left. Eat, then fight.
Don't go near the main hall. The master is... still there.
I will remember this child's dharma name. You need only fight, benefactor.
dialogue.leaders.list.hyegong.yardBloodM: Junior Brother, you're alive! ...Strange. I feel I've said this before.
dialogue.leaders.list.hyegong.join: Whoever's body it was, you were the one who laid my master to rest, benefactor. I will go with you.
dialogue.leaders.list.hyegong.inn.0: I was told three bowls of Madam Unnang's soup is the polite limit. This is my fourth.
dialogue.leaders.list.hyegong.inn.1: I'm grateful to see my brothers' bodies walking again. But I can't sleep at night.
dialogue.leaders.list.hyegong.inn.2: To the very end, my master worried whether I'd eaten. So I leave nothing in the bowl.
dialogue.leaders.list.machil.yardUnknown: Well, well, the brat's alive! I was just warming up my voice to wail for him.
Fancy a sip? No, no. On the day you come back to life, it's rice before wine.
Lots of strange peddlers with lanterns on the night roads lately. If you see one, don't talk. Walk on by.
dialogue.leaders.list.machil.yardKnown.0: Borrowing one of my kids again, eh? This one owes three taels on his wine tab. Pay that off too.
dialogue.leaders.list.machil.yardBloodMo: You're alive, you brat! Funny, seeing your face makes me thirsty. Has that happened before?
dialogue.leaders.list.machil.join: When I heard one of my kids took down a Lord of the Land, I knew right away another soul was in there. That boy never had it in him.
dialogue.leaders.list.machil.inn.0: The innkeeper's smile has gone a bit loose lately. The noisiest place is always behind a smiling face.
dialogue.leaders.list.machil.inn.1: Act drunk and everyone lets things slip in front of you. Nobody's afraid of a drunk beggar.
dialogue.leaders.list.machil.inn.2: I see that the little ones hiding at headquarters get fed. Some of the bodies you've borrowed, I carried on my back when they were small.
dialogue.leaders.list.machil.sister.yard: Well, well, the girl's alive! I was just warming up my voice to wail for her.
Borrowing one of my kids again, eh? This girl owes three taels on her wine tab. Pay that off too.
You're alive, girl! Funny, seeing your face makes me thirsty. Has that happened before?
dialogue.leaders.list.machil.sister.join: When I heard one of my kids took down a Lord of the Land, I knew right away another soul was in there. That girl never had it in her.
dialogue.leaders.list.namgung_hyeon.yard: You're alive! Of course. Namgung blood doesn't yield to a little rain.
I will rebuild the clan. You stand behind me... no, beside me. Beside.
If the clan head were here, none of this would... Never mind. Get your sword.
Namgung colors suit you well enough. Don't shame the name. Come back alive.
You're alive! Your face looks familiar. Well, you're Namgung, so of course it does.
dialogue.leaders.list.namgung_hyeon.join: When I heard a Namgung nobody had cut down a Lord of the Land, I thought the clan was back on its feet. And the soul is an inn's errand boy. So much for my pride.
When the clan stands again, I'll pay off this inn's debts. Probably. Someday.
That night I locked the armory door and hid inside. Don't tell anyone.
If an errand boy can take up a sword, the young master can't stay hidden. Next time I stand in front.
dialogue.leaders.list.namgung_hyeon.sist: You're alive, Junior Sister! Of course. Namgung blood doesn't yield to a little rain.
I will rebuild the clan. You stand behind me, Junior Sister... no, beside me. Beside.
dialogue.leaders.list.dang_yeonhwa.yardK: One of ours this time. The main house probably never even knew this one's name.
I sharpened the flying daggers. They'll fit these hands.
Poison mist follows the wind, so move against it. Try to live a little longer this time.
dialogue.leaders.list.dang_yeonhwa.yardB: You made it. But I feel like I've seen you somewhere. Were you from the main house?
dialogue.leaders.list.dang_yeonhwa.join: I threw the last dagger. So you were the one who dragged it all that way.
dialogue.leaders.list.dang_yeonhwa.inn.0: I boiled the first pot of antidote. It smells exactly like poison.
dialogue.leaders.list.dang_yeonhwa.inn.1: The main-house kids never lent me so much as one dagger. Now there's no one left to lend.
dialogue.leaders.list.dang_yeonhwa.inn.2: The box from my aunt's room... I still haven't thrown it out. My hands shake at the sight of the Blood Shadow seal.
dialogue.leaders.list.dang_yeonhwa.siste: One of our sisters this time. The main house probably never even knew this girl's name.
On our boat again? This one could at least pull an oar.
Fall in the water and I'll fish you out. Next time, you fish me out.
Just try bringing up my father. I'll dump you in the river.
dialogue.leaders.list.ha_yeon.yardBloodM: Alive? You look familiar. Were we on the same boat?
dialogue.leaders.list.ha_yeon.join: I should've finished my father's business with my own hands. I owe you, so I'll pay.
dialogue.leaders.list.ha_yeon.inn.0: I'll drink the innkeeper's wine. But I can't smile at her yet.
dialogue.leaders.list.ha_yeon.inn.1: Bandits or not, we guarded that one stone for three hundred years. And my father sold it.
dialogue.leaders.list.ha_yeon.inn.2: I don't count how many times you die. To me you're just one person.
dialogue.leaders.list.ha_yeon.sister.yar: On our boat again? This sister could at least pull an oar.
Alive, little sister? You look familiar. Were we on the same boat?
dialogue.leaders.list.unhwa.yardKnown.0: You came. This life starts at Wudang too.
dialogue.leaders.list.unhwa.yardKnown.1: Master tried to guard the mountain and became the mountain. You were born again on it.
dialogue.leaders.list.unhwa.yardKnown.2: Even when the Taiji tilts, it comes back to center. You will too, I think.
dialogue.leaders.list.unhwa.yardBloodMoo: Junior Brother, you're safe. Strange... your face doesn't feel new to me.
dialogue.leaders.list.unhwa.join: I still don't know why Master accepted it. I thought I might find out if I followed you.
dialogue.leaders.list.unhwa.inn.0: The last page of Master's journal holds a single line: 'He, too, meant to save people at first.'
dialogue.leaders.list.unhwa.inn.1: Maybe the reversal of yin and yang wasn't a punishment. Master only understood the Blood Demon after taking in its blood qi.
dialogue.leaders.list.unhwa.inn.2: Aren't you afraid when you die? I never got to ask Master that.
dialogue.leaders.list.unhwa.sister.yardK: You came, Junior Sister. This life starts at Wudang too.
dialogue.leaders.list.unhwa.sister.yardB: Junior Sister, you're safe. Strange... your face doesn't feel new to me.
dialogue.leaders.list.baekya.yardKnown.0: Back again. Let's see how many that body can cut down.
dialogue.leaders.list.baekya.yardKnown.1: That body will die again anyway. Cut down one more before it does.
dialogue.leaders.list.baekya.yardKnown.2: You got into this one before it could rise as a jiangshi. Not bad.
dialogue.leaders.list.baekya.join: I heard you come back in a different body every time. Doesn't matter. We only need to go together as far as the Blood Demon.
dialogue.leaders.list.baekya.inn.0: I've forgotten how to smile. I'll think about it after the Blood Demon is dead.
dialogue.leaders.list.baekya.inn.1: The Blood Shadow Society made this arm. I'll return it to them in front of the Blood Demon.
dialogue.leaders.list.baekya.inn.2: That old man doesn't smell of blood. A living person, and he doesn't. First time I've seen that.
dialogue.leaders.list.baekya.sister.yard: You got into this girl before she could rise as a jiangshi. Not bad.
dialogue.lords.list.wongak.cuts.meet1.li: The wooden fish fell silent in the thousand-year-old temple.
dialogue.lords.list.wongak.cuts.kill1.li: The seal... didn't break. It was opened... from inside.
dialogue.lords.list.wongak.phase2: Stand back... This light is not me!
dialogue.lords.list.wongak.bloodMoon: Have you stood in this courtyard before? The great bell weeps so.
dialogue.lords.list.dang_sohye.cuts.meet: The poison meant to stop the jiangshi swallowed the Dang Clan.
What is a branch child doing here?
I came to bring you home, Aunt.
dialogue.lords.list.dang_sohye.cuts.kill: Yeonhwa... the lacquered box in my room... open it.
The recipe for blood poison had come from the Blood Shadow Society.
Aunt, from now on I'll use this poison to save people.
dialogue.lords.list.dang_sohye.phase2: Dang poison scatters even in death.
dialogue.lords.list.dang_sohye.bloodMoon: I've seen that stride before. On some rainy night.
dialogue.lords.list.ma_cheonpae.cuts.mee: Iron Dragon Ma Cheonpae stood untouched in the rain.
If you can't pay the price, I'll eat you.
dialogue.lords.list.ma_cheonpae.cuts.kil: Three hundred years I guarded it... Couldn't I be paid, just once?
The Lower Five Gates had brokered the deal. Unnang's name was on the last line of the ledger.
I told you not to sell it, Father.
dialogue.lords.list.ma_cheonpae.phase2: The river is on my side! This is my pay for three hundred years!
dialogue.lords.list.ma_cheonpae.bloodMoo: I thought we settled our haggling last time. ...When was last time?
The Taiji of Mount Wudang turned backward.
Don't come. The mountain is still holding.
Once I took the blood qi into me... I understood.
The Blood Demon was once... a physician.
Only now did the words 'Heal him' carved on the scabbard seem to make sense.
Master, why did you take that in?
dialogue.lords.list.hyeolheo.phase2: The mountain turns... I told you not to come!
dialogue.lords.list.hyeolheo.bloodMoon: You have walked down this mountain once before.
dialogue.lords.list.huashan_sword_soul.c: The tomb of Mount Hua's founder lay open.
Is it not over...? Does he still live?
That day... I did not cut.
Heal the Blood Demon? There was no telling what was meant to be healed.
If the Blood Demon had once been a physician, 'heal him' had not been empty words.
The surname carved at the end of the scabbard looked familiar.
dialogue.lords.list.huashan_sword_soul.p: I tried not to cut... so why won't the sword stop!
dialogue.lords.list.huashan_sword_soul.b: I know that soul. We met on this cliff once.
dialogue.lords.list.seol_muhyang.cuts.me: Kunlun's shard was already on its way down the mountain.
Don't follow me. I'm giving this back to him.
dialogue.lords.list.seol_muhyang.cuts.ki: My village... nearly died, all of it, three hundred years ago.
He saved us. The one you call the Blood Demon.
The Blood Shadow Society called him their savior.
I should have... given it back.
dialogue.lords.list.seol_muhyang.phase2: No one gets past. I'll block the road to him.
dialogue.lords.list.seol_muhyang.bloodMo: You've crossed this lake before, haven't you? The ice remembers.
A red moon rose over the Heavenly Demon Cult's headquarters.
You smell like someone who died and came back. He'll be glad to see you.
He wanted... a world where no one loses anyone.
Take it. Until the day the Blood Demon dies, and no longer, I'll stand with the orthodox sects.
dialogue.lords.list.hyeokryeon_hwi.phase: Behold, his moon. Death is not the end!
dialogue.lords.list.hyeokryeon_hwi.blood: Back again. This time he'll remember you too.
dialogue.speakers.danmok_hyeon.name: Danmok Hyeon
dialogue.final.enter.cuts.enter1.lines.0: The seven stones are gathered in one place again.
dialogue.final.enter.cuts.enter2.lines.0: The Blood Pool of the Demon-Sealing Valley. The seven you felled block the way once more.
dialogue.final.stages.hyeoleui.text: Your pulse is racing. How many times have you died and come back?
dialogue.final.stages.hyeoleui.bloodMoon: You have walked the Ghost Festival night again. How far will you go this time?
dialogue.final.stages.hyeolhae.text: In this blood, my wife and my daughter would never have died.
dialogue.final.stages.jinhyeolma.text: What covered the sky was not a rain cloud.
dialogue.endings.list.seal.name: Seal
dialogue.endings.list.seal.desc: Bind the Blood Demon again with the seven shards.
dialogue.endings.list.seal.cuts.c1.lines: With seven stones, they bound the Blood Demon once more.
dialogue.endings.list.seal.cuts.c2.lines: The Blood Rain stopped. The martial world began to rise again.
dialogue.endings.list.seal.cuts.c4.lines: Year 32 of Daeun, the full moon of the seventh month.
dialogue.endings.list.inherit.name: Inheritance
dialogue.endings.list.inherit.desc: Accept the whisper and refuse the last Soul-Recalling Needle.
dialogue.endings.list.inherit.cuts.c1.li: With this power, you will never lose anyone again.
dialogue.endings.list.inherit.cuts.c2.li: I heard those words three hundred years ago, too.
dialogue.endings.list.inherit.cuts.c3.li: No rebirth this time. All the borrowed power, held in one body.
dialogue.endings.list.inherit.cuts.c4.li: A new Blood Demon has awakened.
dialogue.endings.list.true.name: Physician's Heart
dialogue.endings.list.true.desc: Elder Mok puts away the needle and walks toward that one.
dialogue.endings.list.true.cuts.c1.lines: You have been sick a long time.
dialogue.endings.list.true.cuts.c2.lines: The physician's heart that broke away returned to where it belonged.
dialogue.endings.list.true.cuts.c3.lines: I meant to save them. Now I will send them back.
dialogue.endings.list.true.cuts.c4.lines: Those who had become jiangshi dissolved like ink and returned to the earth.
dialogue.endings.list.true.cuts.c6.lines: The Soul-Recalling Needle is gone. No more rebirths, no more returns.
dialogue.settlement.lines.prologue.text: On the night of the Ghost Festival, the errand boy of Cheongun Town took up a sword for the first time.
dialogue.settlement.lines.lord_first.tex: {1}, Lord of the Land of {0}. The rain over that land has thinned.
dialogue.settlement.lines.first_hyeongye: Mystic Realm. A place this body's owner never dared to dream of.
dialogue.settlement.lines.shadow.text: Caught by the shadow. The soul barely held on to the needle.
dialogue.settlement.lines.zuohwa.text: Sat down and closed this life by choice.
dialogue.settlement.lines.short.text: This body did not last long in the rain.
dialogue.settlement.lines.any_1.text: The body stays in the rain. The soul returns to the inn.
dialogue.settlement.lines.any_2.bloodMoo: A life has ended. The Blood Moon has not yet set.
dialogue.settlement.lines.any_2.text: A life has ended. The blood rain has not yet stopped.
dialogue.settlement.lines.any_3.text: A nameless disciple of {0} endured {1} in the rain.

ui.stat_help.Growth: Gain more inner energy and level up faster
ui.stat_help.Area: Your techniques cover a wider area

ui.stat_help.Recovery: Restores this much vitality every second
